offering_description.value: Solaris provides on-site power to data centers, energy companies and industrial customers by deploying and operating mobile natural gas generators. It also rents equipment to oilfield operators and pressure-pumping contractors to store and handle fracturing sand at well sites and coordinates sand deliveries.

primary_services.value: On-site power generation; power equipment rental and operation; well-site sand handling equipment rental; sand delivery coordination

customer_segment.value: B2B: Data center operators, industrial companies, oil and gas producers, and pressure-pumping contractors

end_markets.value: Data centers; oil and gas production; industrial facilities

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Rental of mobile generators, associated power equipment and well-site sand handling systems; service fees: Power system operation and maintenance, well-site technical support and sand delivery coordination

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Owns and deploys mobile generator and sand handling fleets for data center, industrial and oilfield customers; service provider: Installs and operates power systems for commercial customers and coordinates sand deliveries for fracturing crews; OEM / manufacturer: Builds proprietary sand handling equipment for its oilfield rental fleet
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; service provider; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: US national: United States, including data center sites and multiple oil and gas basins

specialization.value: diversified: On-site power generation and oilfield sand handling logistics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct equipment rental and service agreements with data center, industrial and oilfield customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Generator air emissions under EPA and state rules, plus workplace safety and trucking requirements

notes: The latest operating footprint and relative scale of the two businesses are uncertain.
